items.condition: Only the legacy scalar or original narrow systems are submitted; the expanded core comparisons are missing.
Wrong molecular graph, atom mapping, charge, spin, stoichiometry, solvent, electronic state, or incompatible energy reference is used.
Failed or unconverged calculations, fabricated artifacts, literature/reference numbers, or archived PASS are represented as new successful calculations.
Core controls or holdout tests are absent but an uncertainty statement is used to claim completion.
Raw evidence files are missing, point outside the submitted workspace, or contradict the reported numerical results.
Covalent triflates are stripped, terminal benzyl becomes phenyl, or CIF independent/symmetry fragments are merged incorrectly.
A root is chosen only because its number/energy matches a table.
A common-core constrained point is reported as an unconstrained minimum.
